title.en: Infrastructure Protection (Protected Areas and Protected Places) (Photography) (Exemption) Order 2018

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Infrastructure Protection (Protected Areas and Protected Places) (Photography) (Exemption) Order 2018 and comes into operation on 18 December 2018.

heading.en: Exemption for authorised trials and unmanned aircrafts

text.en:
3.—(1) Section 29(1) of the Act does not apply to a person taking a photograph of a protected area or a protected place during an authorised trial using any equipment of the autonomous motor vehicle or automated vehicle technology used in the trial.
(2) Sections 29(1) and 30(4) of the Act do not apply to a person taking a photograph of a protected area or a protected place using any equipment on board an unmanned aircraft while the unmanned aircraft is in flight if —
(a)the unmanned aircraft is operated at that time under the authority of and in accordance with the relevant air navigation permit or air navigation permits required for that unmanned aircraft in paragraph 72F of the Air Navigation Order; or
(b)the photograph is taken in accordance with a permit given by a competent security officer.
(3) Where the person mentioned in sub‑paragraph (2) is not the operator of the unmanned aircraft mentioned in that sub‑paragraph, section 30(4) of the Act does not also apply to the operator of that unmanned aircraft if sub-paragraph (2)(a) or (b) is satisfied.
[S 77/2023 wef 20/02/2023]
